description: `webhook.deliver` is S20 T6's mounting (TR11): a webhook is NOT a second listener, it is this surface answering a signed delivery — the signature rides as a PARAM (stdio has no headers, N18) and GitHub's X-Hub-Signature-256 is sugar for the same field. The answer is the five-answer vocabulary, never an error: `did it fire?` asked through a POST gets fired / did not fire / could not say / skipped / refused, with the reason — an unverified signature starts nothing and says so (401 is an OUTCOME here, carried by a transport that only failed if the socket did). The payload reaches the loop labelled third-party DATA (TR10): signatures prove origin, never permission (TR9).

result.reason: the signature did not verify — an unauthenticated delivery starts nothing (a valid signature would prove who sent it, never what they may cause)
